filing_office: North Carolina Secretary of State, Business Registration Division
filing_fee_notes: Base fee. The SOS fee page lists additional electronic transaction charges of 3 for credit cards or 2 for ACH.
registered_agent_rules: The articles must identify a registered agent and registered office. The registered street and mailing addresses must be in North Carolina.
expedite_options: Additional 100 for processing within 24 hours, excluding weekends and holidays; 200 for same-business-day processing when received by noon Eastern time.
annual_report_due: April 15, beginning the year after formation.
unemployment_insurance_agency: North Carolina Division of Employment Security
plain_english_summary: File Articles of Organization and maintain a North Carolina registered agent. File an annual report starting the next year.
common_mistake: Do not skip the annual report just because the LLC has not started doing business.
notes: Scope: ordinary domestic LLC. Official indexed SOS pages were used where direct access returned 403. Name reservation fee is null because the LLC fee schedule lists 10 while the common BE-03 form listing says 30; this conflict was not resolved. Direct formation and name-search URLs, standard processing time, franchise or privilege tax treatment, publication requirements and operating-agreement mandate were not confirmed. The report URL is an official instructions gateway. Online annual reports add the same 3 credit-card or 2 ACH transaction fee.
